Delete stale sessionsRun ⟳
DELETE FROM sessions
WHERE created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
⟳ Running...
Nothing was sent. It runs when you reconnect.
119.today_caption: What hosted Studio shows when you press Run while offline. React Query pauses the request, so “Running...” shows while nothing reaches the database, then the DELETE is sent on reconnect, possibly long after the user walked away.
119.proposed:
Delete stale sessionsRun ⌘↵
!You’re offline. Nothing has been sent to your database. Run again when you’re back online.
DELETE FROM sessions
WHERE created_at < now() - interval '30 days';
Not sent
119.proposed_caption: A warning Admonition from ui-patterns and a disabled Run, driven by React Query’s onlineManager. A run started offline is dropped, never replayed later.
